tagline: Global investment firm managing alternative assets across private equity, credit, and real assets
hero_kpi_rationale: KKR announced a stable dividend policy with an annualized payout of $0.78 per share, reflecting its financial maturity and commitment to shareholders after years of capital growth in the private equity sector.
company_description: KKR & Co. Inc. is a private equity and real estate investment firm specializing in direct and fund of fund investments. It specializes in acquisitions, leveraged buyouts, management buyouts, credit special situations, growth equity, mature, mezzanine, distressed, turnaround, lower middle market, and middle market investments. The firm considers investments in all industries with a focus on software, cybersecurity, fintech, data and information, security, semiconductors, consumer electronics, internet of things (iot), internet, information services, information technology infrastructure, financial technology, network and cyber security architecture, engineering and operations, content, technology and hardware, energy and infrastructure, real estate, services industry with a focus on business services, intelligence, industry-leading franchises and companies in natural resource, containers and packaging, agriculture, airports, ports, forestry, electric utilities, textiles, apparel and luxury goods, household durables, digital media, insurance, brokerage houses, non-durable goods distribution, supermarket retailing, grocery stores, food, beverage, and tobacco, hospitals, entertainment

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.explanation: Annual dividend per share paid to common shareholders
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share of $0.78, payable quarterly ($0.195 per quarter), announced on February 5, 2026

kpis.name: Fee Related Earnings
kpis.explanation: Recurring earnings from management fees and related fees, excluding realized performance revenues.
kpis.description: KKR's Fee Related Earnings reach $3.71 billion in 2025, up 13.7% vs 2024. This metric reflects the strength of the recurring revenue engine within the Asset Management segment.

kpis.name: Management Fees
kpis.explanation: Fees earned by KKR for managing its funds, the primary component of recurring revenues in the Asset Management segment.
kpis.description: Management fees increase by 18.5% in 2025 to reach $4.1 billion, driven by growth in assets under management. They represent the most predictable revenue base for KKR.

kpis.name: Insurance Net Investment Income
kpis.explanation: Net investment income generated by the Insurance segment's investment portfolio (Global Atlantic), before insurance costs.
kpis.description: Insurance segment net investment income reaches $7.22 billion in 2025, up 14.2% vs 2024. It reflects the growing strength of KKR's insurance balance sheet through Global Atlantic.

kpis.name: Total Segment Earnings
kpis.explanation: Sum of operating earnings from all segments (Asset Management, Insurance, Strategic Holdings), a non-GAAP measure of KKR's overall profitability.
kpis.description: Total segment earnings amount to $5.89 billion in 2025, up 6.9% vs 2024. This metric aggregates the operational performance of KKR's three strategic pillars.

kpis.name: Insurance Segment Assets
kpis.explanation: Total assets allocated to KKR's Insurance segment, reflecting the size of Global Atlantic's balance sheet.
kpis.description: Insurance segment assets reach $272.6 billion as of December 31, 2025, up 11.9% vs end-2024. They represent the vast majority of KKR's total assets and demonstrate the growing scale of Global Atlantic.

kpis.name: Fee-Paying AUM
kpis.explanation: Measures the client money KKR manages that generates fees. Indicates the actual size of the business.

kpis.name: Distributable Earnings
kpis.explanation: Measures the earnings KKR can distribute to investors after covering operating expenses and investments.

kpis.name: Total AUM
kpis.explanation: AUM measures the total money KKR manages for its clients, indicating the size and strength of the firm.

kpis.name: Capital Markets Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenues generated by KKR in financial markets through advisory, trading, and investor services.

kpis.name: Performance Fees
kpis.explanation: Fees earned by KKR when its investments exceed performance targets set with clients.

kpis.name: Dividend per Share
kpis.description: Annual dividend per share paid, aggregated from yfinance.dividends over the last seven fiscal years reported by the company.
kpis.signal: Dividend per share of $0.185 in the latest year.

kpis.name: Capital Returned (Dividends)
kpis.description: Capital returned to shareholders via annual dividends, extracted from yfinance.cashflow over the last four fiscal years reported.
kpis.signal: Capital returned to shareholders via dividends of $0.769 billion in the latest year.

kpis.name: Payout Ratio
kpis.description: Payout Ratio = Dividends Paid / Net Income, calculated over the last three fiscal years from yfinance.cashflow and yfinance.income_stmt.
kpis.signal: Portion of net income distributed as dividends: 32.4% in the latest year.

kpis.name: Earnings per Share
kpis.explanation: Net income divided by the weighted average number of diluted shares outstanding during the fiscal year. Helps assess the company's ability to generate earnings per share: basis for Payout Ratio (DPS / EPS).
kpis.description: 5-year history (2021-2025). Source: yfinance income statement (Diluted EPS).

risks.title: Regulation
risks.summary: Changes in regulations and laws applicable to alternative asset managers could affect KKR's business and financial results
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in Risk Factors, impact on compliance and fund structures

risks.title: Litigation
risks.summary: Litigation and legal proceedings could impact KKR's operations and financial results
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in the Legal Proceedings section (Note 24), currently limited impact
